title: clinopodium serpyllifolium
intro: Clinopodium serpyllifolium, commonly known as Rock Mint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial health benefits, making it useful in treating various conditions such as skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rock Mint include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, as well as its use as a topical application to reduce pain and inflammation. Bioactive constituents of Rock Mint include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
